The company shows strong profitability (EBIT margin ~33% and net margin ~21%) and a solid equity base (shareholders’ equity exceeds total liabilities in level terms, with liabilities/asset ~52%). However, liquidity is weak (current ratio ~0.79), increasing reliance on ongoing operations to meet near-term obligations. Overall credit quality appears solid but not at the very top tier due to the current liquidity profile.  

DECISION: A-
